name: Report Line 1
definition: Information about a payment against a purchase order.

TransactionIdentification.name: Transaction Identification
TransactionIdentification.definition: Unique identification assigned by the matching application to the transaction.

TransactionStatus.name: Transaction Status
TransactionStatus.definition: Identifies the status of the transaction.

PurchaseOrderReference.name: Purchase Order Reference
PurchaseOrderReference.definition: Unique identification of the purchase order, assigned by the buyer.

PurchaseOrderTotalNetAmount.name: Purchase Order Total Net Amount
PurchaseOrderTotalNetAmount.definition: Total amount of the purchase order after taxes, adjustments and charges.

AccumulatedNetAmount.name: Accumulated Net Amount
AccumulatedNetAmount.definition: Accumulated net amount, after adjustments, intended to be paid.

TransactionAndPurchaseOrderRule.definition: The transaction identification and purchase order must match, that is, the purchase order must be the one contained in the baseline/transaction, identified by the transaction identification.
